fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-65b5a3d6 at 2554db589: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok; new TestPlanPrePushFix checks, for plan and plan-milestone, that open-pr and rebase on.fail = prepush-triage, prepush-triage runs `rhiza ship gate --failed` with only on.pass = prepush-fix (no on.fail), and prepush-fix is an agent step with max_visits 2, only on.pass = open-pr, and a prompt telling it to commit; TestPlanBuiltin's order and route table updated likewise. A build of this commit's `rhiza workflow describe plan` and `describe plan-milestone` both list prepush-triage (-> prepush-fix) and prepush-fix (-> open-pr) with open-pr/rebase on.fail -> prepush-triage. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipGate ok: TestShipGateFailed exits 1 with no kept head (a rebase conflict records none), TestShipGateFailedOnPrePushFailure exits 1 after a gh or push error (nothing recorded), 0 on the recorded pre-push-failed head, 1 once HEAD moves. make self-check fails here only on stale rendered actor pages and index.md for this run's committed actor records (the known in-run render staleness, rendered at close-out); in a scratch worktree at this commit, `rhiza render` then `rhiza check` reports no fail. Diff read: plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml changes are identical; cli.md --failed text updated.
